featured_reviews.name: jaypratap yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and unsafe experience at the 9D Cinema operated by Zen Enterprises in Maxus Mall, Bhayandar.

The staff here are extremely immature and completely incapable of handling even basic situations. They lack proper training and professionalism, which makes the whole experience frustrating and uncomfortable for visitors.

What is even more concerning is the poor hygiene. The area and equipment do not appear to be cleaned properly, which raises serious health concerns, especially when children are using the facility.

Safety standards also seem to be completely ignored. There was no proper supervision or safety guidance provided for children, which is absolutely unacceptable for an attraction like this. When kids are involved, safety should be the top priority, but clearly that is not the case here.

Overall, this place is poorly managed and not worth the money. I would strongly advise parents and families to think twice before letting their children use this attraction.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: Maxus Fun World is a place to play arcade games with your friends, it's located inside Maxus Mall in Bhayandar West. There are many games inside like bowling, pool, dashing cars, kids play area, and more arcade games. The place is cool but it needs to be maintained better, charging ₹400 for bowling should atleast be reasonable, the lights, screens and bowling lanes aren't like the other bowling alleys that charge similar prices. The staff was good. Over-all it is a good place but needs to be maintained better.

featured_reviews.name: Amaan Lahora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Mall is a decent place to explore if you’re just looking to spend some time. The food court on the second floor is a bit pricey, and the food quality is average.

As for the kids gaming and play area, it costs ₹100 per play, which feels expensive considering how short the duration is, it’s over just as the child starts enjoying it, lasting barely a minute.

On the positive side, the parking space is good. Also, just opposite the mall, there are food stalls where you can enjoy vegetarian chaat that’s reasonably priced and tastes quite good.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today (30.11.2025), I visited the Funzone with my two children. At the entry, the staff insisted that I must purchase a new entry card, costing Rs. 20 per card, and clearly mentioned that it is non-refundable. After using it, the card has no value or use for us. When I requested the staff to take the card back, they refused.

It appears that Funzone is earning extra money by forcing every customer to buy these cards unnecessarily. The behavior of the staff was rude—saying, “If you want, buy it, otherwise get lost,” which is unacceptable in a family entertainment place.

Parents should be aware of this unnecessary extra spending. Funzone is taking advantage of children’s interest and parents’ emotions to force these charges. This practice is unfair and feels like a way to make extra money from every visitor.

featured_reviews.name: Sundae
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good initiative but not so well maintained.

People usually come here for gym or swimming but on weekends badminton and TT too. On weekends, it could get crowded.

There’s badminton, gymnastics, pool, snooker, table tennis, lawn tennis, swimming, gym, basketball, squash and few other sports.

Instructor for swimming(Arjun Sir) is very very helpful but there's only one instructor at a time and you only have 45m session each day. So he would hardly be able to give 3-5 mins to you if there are many students in your session.

Good thing is you can join any session, irrespective of what you signed up for during coaching registration.

It does not matter how old are you, he will teach you swimming easily, you just have to show up. Arjun Sir’s timing are 10-12 AM if you wish to learn from him. He makes sure you learn and it’s effortless.

Swimming pool length is
25 meters x 12.5 meters.

Memberships are very affordable imo especially if you coming in a group. The only problem is every time you need to give them a photograph for id card, which is annoying.

Swimming costume compulsory.
Instructor are very hard working and life guards are very friendly.
Yearly Package for adults will cost you around 6000 now in sept 2018.
And for 6 months fees is 4000.
Crowd is very descent and classy.
If the review was informative please like the review.

featured_reviews.review_text: I loved the vibe of this place. There is a play/gaming zone and inside is a preminum restaurant with a bowling alley. The decor and ambience are aesthetically pleasing. The staff is mindful and attentive. We went for a dine out and for the first time I have no complaints about the food. The food quality and quantity surpasses any other restaurants I have been to so far! 10/10 for the food!! Please do not change your chefs!! Overall the feel was good. Just one aspect which was a bit not for me was the music. The taste of the music was really good I mean it is meant for the millennials but it was a tad bit too loud. I would prefer to have two volumes down for the music because when I’m with my friends and dinning I’d like to talk and hear them rather than screaming 🤣. But I loved the place and would definitely go again! And also recommend others for their food quality. Also I was in a rush since we went there after 11 pm (after movie scenes) so there aren’t a lot of good pictures but hope to click some more the next time if I get a chance to go here again!

featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited The Game Palacio in the Lakeshore Mall formerly known as Viviana Mall. It is a game zone where all age groups can spend time and have fun. featured_reviews.review_text: Had the best team bonding experience ❤️ Perfect mid week reset ever! The music , energy, lights , delicious spring rolls and playing Bowling together was the best!

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Game Palacio at lakeshore mall Thane, with my friend and had a fantastic experience overall. The place is vibrant, well organized, and perfect for spending quality time.
The food was really delicious and well presented everything we ordered tasted fresh and flavorful, and it was absolutely worth it.
A very special thanks to Vaishnav for his outstanding service. He was extremely polite, attentive, and supportive throughout our visit. He made sure we were comfortable and enjoying the dining experience. His professionalism and positive attitude truly deserve appreciation.
Thank you, Vaishnav, for making our visit memorable. He truly deserves big appreciation from his manager ✨

featured_reviews.name: Saffan Memon
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to sincerely appreciate Mr. Mubashir for his professionalism and responsibility.
When my tablet was damaged in the game zone, he handled the situation with great care.
He ensured proper follow-up and took ownership of the matter.
The next day, he responsibly handed over the replacement/device without any delay.
His dedication, accountability, and helpful attitude are truly commendable.

featured_reviews.name: samreen siddiqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Perfect Blend of Fun, Food, and Fabulous Service!

I recently visited The Game Palacio, Mumbai, and it turned out to be such a memorable experience! The moment I walked in, I was impressed by the stylish ambience and lively vibe – it really sets the mood for both dining and entertainment.

The staff were courteous, attentive, and genuinely eager to make our time enjoyable. Special mention to the servers who made great recommendations and ensured everything was served just right.

The food was delicious – from starters to desserts, every dish was well-presented and flavourful. The drinks were equally impressive, refreshing and perfectly crafted.

Of course, the highlight was the game zone! The bowling alley, arcade games, and overall setup made it more than just a restaurant – it’s a complete experience. Whether you’re with friends, family, or colleagues, there’s something for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Ramesh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience.
We ordered a pizza and were told it would arrive in 10 minutes, but it took around 40 minutes. By the time the food arrived, our bowling game had already ended. When we requested cancellation due to the excessive delay, the staff insisted on bringing it anyway.
The bigger issue was the complete lack of coordination among the staff. We were seated at a table by one waiter, and later another staff member (surname Chikne) came and told us to leave because the table was reserved. When I explained that their own waiter had seated us there, he denied it. Only after confronting both staff members together did the waiter finally admit that he had indeed seated us there.
To make matters worse, when we asked for drinking water before leaving, we were told they don't serve water. We then asked for a Bisleri bottle and were informed that wasn't available either.
Poor service, poor communication, long delays, and rude customer handling. The staff seemed more interested in arguing than resolving customer issues. Definitely not the experience one expects after paying for a fun outing.
Would not recommend until management improves staff training and customer service. 👎

featured_reviews.name: yogesh gavhane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited The Game Palacio at Viviana Mall in Thane, and it was an absolute blast! This place is a fantastic entertainment hub that seamlessly blends fun, food, and excitement for all ages. From the moment I walked in, the vibrant and stylish ambiance set the tone for an unforgettable experience.
The gaming arcade was equally impressive, offering a mix of classic games like Pac-Man and thrilling VR experiences that transported me into another world. The variety ensures there’s something for everyone, from kids to adults looking to relive their arcade days.
The dining experience was just as delightful. The menu, with its Asian-inspired dishes and creative cocktails.
The staff was attentive and ensured everything ran smoothly.
Whether you’re planning a family outing, a birthday bash, or a corporate event, the private party rooms.
Overall, The Game Palacio in Thane is a must-visit for anyone looking for a fun-filled day. It’s the perfect mix of entertainment, dining, and a lively atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at Shott! 🎳 The bowling experience was super fun, and the vibe of the place is just perfect for hanging out with friends. We had pre-booked our table, everything was well managed, and the food was really good too. Definitely coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Kalyani Kasat
featured_reviews.review_text: Such a fun experience at Shott Playing Zone! Bowling and laser wars were super exciting, and we had an amazing time. Also, the French fries were really tasty!🤩🤩

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Godbole
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at SHOTT Mumbai! The bowling, arcade games, and overall vibe were fantastic. The place is well-maintained, the staff is helpful, and there are plenty of activities to keep everyone entertained. Perfect spot for a fun outing with friends, family, or even a date. The food and drinks were great too. Definitely looking forward to visiting again! 🎳

featured_reviews.name: Chandu B
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: We went here primarily for bowling. We purchased an offline card. We paid 3100 plus tax(3600) and got 3500 as balance. We also got a BOGO offer in bowling. We selected VIP bowling and it had animation and graphics on the bowling floor and of course the normal bowling was crowded. They have very good combination of arcade and normal games and we had fun here. Staff was very helpful and we had some issues with machine and my card got swiped multiple times. They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. They also have lot of offers and we got few extra bonus points for their social media posts.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Rajeshirke
featured_reviews.review_text: Best experience and worth it. Had so much fun with friends. Also the staff is very humble and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Saunskaar Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited SHOTT Mumbai for my college event, and it was an amazing experience. The venue offers a fantastic arcade, a bowling area, a section for drinks and snacks, and dedicated rooms for parties and events. The vibe here is superb, and the staff is incredibly cooperative, making the experience even better. If you're looking for a fun and lively place for entertainment or events, SHOTT Mumbai is definitely worth checking out!

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an awesome time at Timezone in Capital Mall, Vasai East. The VR ride was truly out of this world. I chose the Halloween game, and it was so immersive and spooky. I felt like. The VR headset and equipment were super clean and comfortable, and the whole setup was well maintained. Each ride lasted about 10 minutes, which was just the right length for me. At ₹200 per person per ride, it's a bit on the pricier side, but the experience is definitely worth it.

The VR rides were the highlight of our visit, but the arcade games were also fun and engaging. The bowling alley, though small, was still enjoyable, and I had a good time. The only downside was that the place can get quite crowded, especially on weekends, and the AC sometimes struggles to keep up

Despite the occasional crowd and warm temperatures, I had a great time at Timezone Capital Mall
